name: КАНЦЕЛЯРИЯ
description: Локальный разборщик сохранений Europa Universalis V: паспорт кампании, экономика, армии и диагностика формата.
changelog: Added local import for plaintext and ZIP-compressed Europa Universalis V saves.
Added a streaming Clausewitz parser with campaign metadata, economy, population, army, navy and war extraction.
Added IndexedDB campaign persistence, duplicate detection, diagnostics and an offline mobile interface.
